name: Centaur
body:
Known as skilled hunters and warriors, centaurs are magical, six-limbed creatures with the torso of a humanoid (usually resembling a human) atop the lower body of a hooved mammal (usually that of a horse).

Physical

The human-horse hybrid is the best known version of the centaur. Most have the torsos of humans with tanned skin and wide, sturdy features, which taper into the lower bodies with typical equine coloration.

However, more rare varieties have torsos that appear more like elves or other humanoids; have lower bodies that resemble antelopes, bison, or sheep; have coloration like zebras or stranger animals; are considerably smaller; have antlers or horns; or feature other cosmetic variations.

Social

Most centaurs travel in herds. They live a simple life of hunting and gathering, and prefer open natural spaces, such as plains or forests. However, not all centaurs ascribe to this traditional lifestyle, and individual centaurs can be found anywhere humanoids are found—as long as there is enough room for their bulky bodies to maneuver.

Although they are proud warriors, centaurs prefer to trade rather than to fight. They get along well with most other centaurs, as well as with people who respect the natural world. They are especially fond of elves, but tend to see humans as suspicious and overly aggressive.

Alignment and Religion

Centaurs tend to be Neutral, seeing life as a lesson in practicality. More centaurs lean toward Chaos than Law, although there are fair numbers on both sides of that divide.

However, few centaurs opt for the path of Evil, with most choosing Good should they deviate from Neutrality.

Centaurs take many of their lessons from nature, and their traditional religion venerates a pantheon of nature deities and fey lords.

Note: The centaur as presented here is suggested as an alternative to the original monstrous humanoid version.

Base Traits
Ability Score Modifiers You are strong and intuitive. Your ability score adjustments are +2 Str, +2 Wis [flexible]. Note: After your modifiers for being size Large are incorporated, your net ability score adjustments are: +4 Str, +2 Wis, –2 Dex.
Size As a Large creature, you have a –1 size penalty on attack rolls, a –1 size penalty to your Armor Class, a +1 size bonus to your CMB, and a –4 size penalty on Stealth checks. As a Large creature, you occupy a space of 10 feet by 10 feet. Your reach is 5 feet. You take a further –2 penalty to Dex, and gain a further +2 bonus to Str.
Type You are a Monstrous Humanoid.
Senses Darkvision. You have darkvision 60 feet.
Speed Fast. Your base speed is 40 feet.
Languages You begin play speaking Common and Sylvan. If you have a high Intelligence score, you can choose from any of the following languages: Celestial, Elven, Gnome, or Halfling.
Alternate Traits
Hooves You can make two hoof attacks. These are secondary natural attacks that deal 1d6 bludgeoning damage each (1d4 if you are size Medium).
Natural Armor Your tough hide provides you with a +1 natural armor bonus.
Quadruped Your four legs provide you with a +4 species bonus to CMD against trip attempts and a +10 foot bonus to your land speed (included in your speed, above). You use the quadruped rules to determine your carrying capacity. You use weapons as if you were size Medium instead of Large.
Weapon Familiarity You are proficient with longbows (including composite longbows) and longswords.
